newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's King Hussein leaves for Spain, U.S..
newsitem.headline: Jordan's King Hussein leaves for Spain, U.S..

text.p: King Hussein left Jordan on Wednesday on a trip to Spain and the United States, where he is due to discuss the troubled Middle East peace process with President Bill Clinton.
The king, who launched a bitter attack on Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu this week accusing him of destroying hopes for Arab-Israeli peace, did not speak to reporters before his departure.
King Hussein is expected to meet meet Clinton, senior defence and state department officials and congressional leaders next week after a regular health check-up. He was treated for cancer in 1992.
Prince Hassan said a planned meeting of U.S., European and Arab envoys in Gaza on Saturday to discuss Israel's settlement plans in the West Bank would be "a healthy opportunity to explore views".

"Let's remember the confrontation is not one of Arab and Israeli or Palestinian and Israeli," he said. "It is one between those who believe in building and consolidating peace and those who have other agendas."
